facts.statement: Cuspirostrisornis is a genus of extinct bird.
facts.quote: genus: Cuspirostrisornis

facts.statement: The only known species within the genus is Cuspirostrisornis houi.
facts.quote: species: houi

facts.statement: The genus Cuspirostrisornis was described by Hou in 1997.
facts.quote: parent_authority: Hou, 1997

facts.statement: Cuspirostrisornis belongs to the extinct subclass Enantiornithes.
facts.quote: subclassis: Enantiornithes

facts.statement: The species is classified within the family Avisauridae.
facts.quote: familia: Avisauridae

facts.statement: Cuspirostrisornis lived during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically the Aptian age, approximately 120.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: The Jiufotang Formation is dated to the Early Cretaceous period, Aptian age, 120.3 +/-0.7 million years ago.

facts.statement: The animal is known from a single fossil found in the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, China.
facts.quote: It is known from one fossil found in the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, People's Republic of China.

facts.statement: The holotype fossil was collected in 1993 by Dr. Hou Lianhai and Hou Jinfeng.
facts.quote: It was collected in 1993 by Dr. Hou Lianhai and Hou Jinfeng

facts.statement: The holotype fossil is cataloged as IVPP V 10897.
facts.quote: The fossil is given catalog number IVPP V 10897.

facts.statement: The holotype represents a small perching bird with a skull measuring about 27 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: The holotype fossil is that of a small perching bird, with a skull about 27 millimeters (1 inch) long.

facts.statement: The skull possessed ten pairs of tiny teeth, five in the premaxilla and five in the anterior dentary.
facts.quote: There are five pairs of tiny teeth in the premaxilla, and another five pairs in the anterior dentary.

facts.statement: The describer Hou identified the pointed snout as being proportionally similar to the beaks of modern wagtails (genus Motacilla).
facts.quote: It had a pointed snout which Hou identified as a beak proportionally similar to the beaks of the extant genus Motacilla, the wagtails.

facts.statement: It is debated whether tooth-bearing prehistoric birds like Cuspirostrisornis possessed a horny beak over their toothed snouts.
facts.quote: However, some have noted that there is no evidence that the snouts of tooth-bearing prehistoric birds such as most enantiornitheans would also have possessed a horny beak, at least in a toothed part of the snout.

facts.statement: The ulna is large and derived, featuring an S-shape similar to that of modern flying birds.
facts.quote: The ulna is large and derived, with the s-shape of modern flying birds.

facts.statement: The sternum is described as large, carinate, and broad.
facts.quote: The sternum is large, carinate, and broad.

facts.statement: Cuspirostrisornis is an extinct genus of enantiornithean bird.
facts.quote: Cuspirostrisornis es un género extinto de ave enantiornitea.

facts.statement: While only one species is known, some researchers believe Cuspirostrisornis houi is a synonym of the similar species Cathayornis yandica.
facts.quote: Solo se conoce una especie, Cuspirostrisornis houi, aunque algunos investigadores creen que es un sinónimo de la especie similar Cathayornis yandica.

facts.statement: The fossil was collected from light gray mudstones approximately two kilometers west of Boluochi Village in Chaoyang County, Liaoning Province.
facts.quote: Se recolectó de lutitas de color gris claro aproximadamente a dos kilómetros al oeste de la aldea de Boluochi, condado de Chaoyang, provincia de Liaoning.

facts.statement: The ulna is large and derived, having the S-shape of modern flying birds.
facts.quote: El cúbito es grande y derivado, con la forma de S de las aves voladoras modernas.

facts.statement: The sternum is large, carinate, and broad.
facts.quote: El esternón es grande, carinado y ancho.

facts.statement: The generic name derives from Latin words meaning "pointed" and "beak".
facts.quote: El nombre genérico proviene de las palabras latinas para "puntiagudo" y "pico",

facts.statement: The specific name refers to the describer, Mr. Hou Jinfeng.
facts.quote: y el epíteto específico se refiere a su descriptor, el Sr. Hou Jinfeng, mencionado anteriormente.

facts.statement: The genus Cuspirostrisornis is part of the parent group Cuspirostrisornithidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Cuspirostrisornithidae
